title: The WhileExpr AST Node
description: A dataclass node for a while expression, holding the condition, the body, and the source line. The parser will build this node once it knows the while syntax.

steps.description: This adds the `WhileExpr` AST node in `ast_nodes.py`. The page says to add it where your AST nodes live.
`@dataclass` generates the boilerplate for the class. `WhileExpr` is the node the parser builds for a `while` expression.

The node holds three fields: `cond`, the condition; `body`, the loop body; and `line`, the source line. The page says that after this change the `ParseError` about `while` is gone, but a new error appears because the parser still does not produce a `WhileExpr`.
